# DATASCI 350 - Quiz 2
## Reproducible Research and Quarto

### Quiz Day Setup
- **Fork** the quiz repository on the GitHub website
- Open the terminal and clone the fork
    - cd ~/Desktop
    - git clone https://github.com/mollym425/datasci350-quiz02.git
- In VS Code: File --> Add Folder to Workspace --> select quiz folder
- In the terminal, move to the quiz folder and check:
    - cd ~/Desktop/datasci350-quiz02
    - pwd
    - git status
- Open **commands.txt** in VS Code or create it with:
    - touch commands.txt
- Check quarto
    - quarto check
- Preview the website
    - quarto preview --> Ctrl+C to stop
- Render the website
    - quarto render
- Git add, commit, and push changes
- Publish the website
    - quarto publish gh-pages
- Submit the fork’s URL and the website's URL on Canvas

### Reproducible Research
- README.md should include each data source and its download date, the rebuild commands in run order (ready to paste), the language and package versions
```{python}
# print package versions
import sys, numpy, pandas
print("python:", sys.version.split()[0])
print("numpy :", numpy.__version__)
print("pandas:", pandas.__version__)
```

### Quarto
- **quarto check** - checks versions, diagnoses Quarto installation and supporting tools
- **quarto --help** - lists every command
- **quarto render report.qmd** - render a file to its default format
    - **quarto render report.qmd --to pdf** - render file to pdf
    - **quarto render report.qmd --to html** - render file to html
    - **quarto render report.qmd --to docx** - render file to docx
    - **quarto render report.qmd --to revealjs** - render file to slides
- **quarto convert notebook.ipynb** - convert a Jupyter notebook to .qmd
    - **quarto convert report.qmd** - convert .qmd to a Jupyter notebook
- **quarto preview report.qmd** - render, open in the browser, and re-render on every save

### Code Chunks
```{python}
#| label: fig-label-name
#| echo: false
#| warning: false

# code here

```

Code chunk displays a table, and the table can be referenced by @tbl-cof-hap-means
```{python}
#| label: tbl-cof-hap-means
#| tbl-cap: "Mean coffee consumption and mean happiness by country, sorted by coffee consumption, highest first"
#| echo: false


means = (coffee.groupby("country")[["coffee_kg_per_capita", "happiness_score"]].mean().sort_values("coffee_kg_per_capita", ascending=False))

means
```

- **#| label: fig-name** - labels a figure
- **#| label: tbl-name** - labels a table
- **#| fig-cap: "..."** - put a caption under the figure
- **#| warning: false** - hide the warnings
- **#| echo: false** - hide the code, keep the output
- **#| eval: false** - do not run code (visibility depends on echo)
- **#| include: false** - run the code, show nothing
- **#| layout-ncol: 2** - arrange the outputs in columns
- **@fig-name** - prints the figure numbered and linked for you
- **{#sec-name}** - labels a heading; ex: "## Meet Quarto {#sec-introduction}"; needs number-sections: true

### Markdown
- **bold**
- *italic*
- ~~scratch that~~
- [text](url)
- ![caption](img.png)
- `code`
- > quote - get a blockquote
- 2^10^, H~2~O
- 'footnote[^1]' - get a numbered footnote
    - somewhere else: '[^1]: This is the footnote text.'
- Tables: 

| Left | Center | Right |
|:-----|:------:|------:|
| a    | b      | c     |


### Citations with BibTex
- **bibliography: references.bib** - add to the YAML header to point it at the file
- **@reference** → LastName (Year)
- **[@reference]** → (LastName Year)
- **[@reference, p. 10]** → (LastName Year, 10)

### Parameterised Reports
- Requires papermill package
- Add a python code chunk with the 2 lines (first):
    - #| tags: [parameters]
    - parameter = "default_option"
- **quarto render report.qmd -P parameter:new_option** - overrides the default option
- **`{python} parameter`** - inline code; puts a Python value into your text
- **quarto render report.qmd -P parameter:new_option --output file-new_option.html** - outputs file to a different name

### Website
Every Quarto website has:
- **_quarto.yml** - site configuration: title, navigation, theme
- **index.qmd** - home page (required)
- ***.qmd** - other pages: about, posts, docs, etc.

Freeze (added to _quarto.yml)
- **freeze: auto** - new code, new results. No change, same results
    - Saved results live in _freeze/; commit this folder.
- **freeze: true** - never re-run. For archival work, like a submitted paper
- **freeze: false** - the default, always re-run

Publish
- **quarto publish gh-pages** - Quarto publishes to GitHub Pages (https://mollym425.github.io/repo-name/)

**_quarto.yml skeleton**:

project:
  type: website

website:
  title: "TITLE"
  navbar:
    left:
      - href: index.qmd
        text: Home
      - href: page2.qmd
        text: Page2
      - href: page3.qmd
        text: Page3
      - href: page4.qmd
        text: Page4

execute:
  freeze: auto

format:
  html:
    theme:
      light: cosmo
    toc: true
